correctness.rationale: The crown automorphisms are simultaneous permutations of matching indices and optional side swap. Properness restricts cross-side shared colors to unique diagonal pairs; distinct ordered color pairs eliminate all simultaneous-permutation stabilizers, and at least one nondiagonal pair removes side swap. Choosing t shared diagonal positions/colors, a and b exclusive palettes and injective onto placements in a-by-b cells gives precisely the U(a,b;n-t) inclusion-exclusion formula with no quotient by color labels. The optimal mixed threshold follows by maximizing t+floor((k-t)^2/4) for 1<=t<=k-2 and the known k=ceil(2sqrt(n)). Check n=3 separately. This is an all-n,q bijective argument, not an extrapolation from brute force.
